name: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom renovation in Orange County can vary significantly based on its size, the quality of materials selected, and the extent of structural changes. A small powder room update might start around $8,000-$15,000, while a mid-range master bathroom remodel could range from $20,000 to $40,000 or more. High-end custom bathrooms with luxury finishes, reconfigured layouts, or extensive plumbing adjustments can exceed $50,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovation costs in Orange County vary widely, from around $8,000 for a small update to over $50,000 for a high-end master remodel.
